difficulty_reason: The proof retains a nonroutine bridge between noncommutative quantum-torus monomials and s-valent refined tropical multiplicities, then classifies the nonvanishing degenerate graph types under descendant/point/lambda constraints. The logarithmic gluing argument handles the descendant setting where the earlier no-codimension-two argument fails, using combinatorial flatness and dimension-controlled diagonal splitting. Weight, automorphism and sine-series factors are assembled in the current proof. The final formal substitution alone is not the counted difficulty-bearing unit.
